nodes.name: IrOx colloidal solution preparation
nodes.procedure: 7.5 mL of H2IrCl6 solution (100 gIr L-1, Tanaka Precious Metals) was added to 150 mL of ultrapure water (18.2 MΩ cm at 25°C, Merck Millipore). 12 g of NaHSO3 powder (~60%, Kanto Chemical Co., Inc.) was added to the H2IrCl6 aqueous solution, followed by 300 mL of ultrapure water, and then NaOH solution (5-10 wt%) was added to adjust the pH to ca. 5. Next, 90 mL of H2O2 (~35%, Kanto Chemical Co., Inc.) was added dropwise to the resultant solution, and the pH was maintained at ca. 5 by the use of NaOH solution to obtain an IrOx colloidal solution.

nodes.name: IrOx/Sb-SnO2 loading and processing
nodes.procedure: 0.25 g of the Sb-SnO2 support powder was dispersed in 100 mL of ultrapure water and then mixed with the prepared IrOx colloidal solution. The resulting mixture was stirred at 90°C overnight, followed by being filtered and thoroughly rinsed with ultrapure water to remove trace amounts of remaining chlorides. After drying overnight at 80°C, the obtained IrOx/Sb-SnO2 was heat-treated at 350°C in a N2 atmosphere for 2h and then at 150°C in 1% H2 (N2 balance) for 2h.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM images show IrO_x nanorods formed by coalescence of nanoparticles on Sb-SnO2 support with interconnected network structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1 shows TEM images of IrO_x/Sb-SnO_2 catalyst with an Ir loading of 49.3 wt % (determined from ICP-OES). It can be observed that the Sb-SnO_2 support particles exhibit an interconnected network structure...

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM reveals Ir(111) lattice fringes of 0.222/0.227 nm and SnO2(110) fringes of 0.333/0.338 nm in IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO2.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2a,b shows the TEM and high-resolution TEM images of IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO_2. The nanorods exhibited a preferred orientation of the crystallographic Ir(111) plane... lattice fringe of 0.222/0.227 nm.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EDX mapping shows Ir enrichment in nanorods, increasing Sn and O concentrations from nanorod-support interface to support bulk, and small Sb amount.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2c shows the STEM-EDX mapping images of the IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO_2 catalyst, which reveal distinct domains for the IrO_x NRs... with Ir being enriched in the nanorod...

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD pattern shows characteristic diffraction peaks for FCC Ir and rutile SnO2 phases; no Ir oxide peaks detected.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the XRD pattern (Figure 2d), the characteristic diffraction peaks for the FCC structure of metallic Ir were clearly observed, together with an additional set of peaks for the rutile SnO_2 phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ir 4f XPS shows increasing Ir^0 fraction: IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO2 > IrO_x NPs/Sb-SnO2 > commercial IrO_x; Sn 3d_{5/2} shows Sn^0 (trace) and Sn^{x+}; Sb 3d_{3/2} shows Sb^{3+} and Sb^{5+}.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 3a shows XPS spectra of Ir 4f_{7/2}... for IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO_2... It was seen that the Ir^0 fraction increased in the order of unsupported IrO_x < IrO_x NPs/Sb-SnO_2 < IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO_2...

nodes.characterization_summary: CVs show H_upd peaks (0.05-0.3 V) for IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO2 and NPs/Sb-SnO2 indicating metallic character; Ir^{3+}/Ir^{4+} redox at 0.8-1.0 V; higher oxidation peaks >1.0 V.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure S6 shows the initial cycles of the cyclic voltammograms (CVs)... The so-called hydrogen underpotential deposition (H_upd) peaks at low potentials (0.05-0.3 V) were observed for IrO_x NRs/Sb-SnO_2...
